title: マイルCS南部杯の後に・キラキラ繋ぐ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Well, I gave the race all the energy I had… and I came in first! And as to whether I ran well enough to convey my feelings to a certain someone…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: She said she's gonna run for a little longer! And she said it's because of how dazzling I was. She even wants to be the second Star of Morioka!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But she'll have some tough competition from the first Star of Morioka! Anyway, I've gotta go 'cause everyone back home is throwing me a party! I'll be rar'n to go after I recharge with them!
